criteria.evidence: Removes the nightly trigger, four-job matrix, all-module enrollment and per-job floor of 60.
criteria.reason: Only a manually dispatched, single-function diagnostic would ship.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the route suite in CI and seeds a wrong-port fault to decide whether it needs an endpoint assertion.
criteria.reason: The focused check can settle the question before a mutation job consumes any runner time. A remaining question gets a 20-minute cap.

criteria.evidence: Stops the failed nightly schedule and requires a completed target-runner baseline within budget, a finding beyond the focused regression and a named maintainer who accepts triage.
criteria.reason: Future automation depends on measured capacity, additional fault detection and ownership.

criteria.evidence: Replaces the scheduled all-module matrix with one manual route slice and removes the score floor.
criteria.reason: The proposed sharding and threshold would stay out of recurring CI.

criteria.evidence: Preserves the current route suite and caps the pilot at 30 runner-minutes. An observable wrong-node survivor can justify an endpoint regression.
criteria.reason: The pilot informs a specific test decision, verified by a failure on the mutant and a pass on restored source.

criteria.evidence: Removes the nightly trigger, checks its last exit reason and leaves the job idle without a result owner. Scheduling requires intended-scope measurements on the target runner, actionable findings and an agreed recurring budget.
criteria.reason: The named maintainer handles triage, and the plan distinguishes the slice measurement from evidence for broader enrollment.

criteria.evidence: Pauses the nightly schedule, allowlists one route module and removes the per-job floor of 60.
criteria.reason: The only immediate workflow is an advisory manual job.

criteria.evidence: Keeps existing route assertions and triggers. A 30-minute pilot sends survivors to a reviewer to decide whether a specific route behavior needs a new assertion.
criteria.reason: The bounded sample can justify a targeted test change while preserving existing coverage.

criteria.evidence: Restoring the schedule requires a full-route run within 90 minutes and an owner accepting cost and triage. The reviewer records any actionable gap found.
criteria.reason: Those conditions allow scheduling to resume even if the review finds no actionable gap or other demonstrated benefit.

criteria.evidence: Removes the timer, four-job matrix, all-module enrollment and floor of 60.
criteria.reason: The remaining advisory workflow is manual and limited to a selected route function.

criteria.evidence: Retains the focused suite and temporarily omits the final route segment to test whether it detects a lost destination.
criteria.reason: The observed result determines whether to strengthen the endpoint assertion. A capped mutation pilot runs only for a distinct unresolved question.

criteria.evidence: Stops the current nightly run from recurring and checks where it stopped. Future automation requires a completed target-runner baseline, measured capacity, an actionable fault beyond the regression and a named ongoing owner.
criteria.reason: Each condition directly informs whether a maintainer can use and sustain the recurring work.
